notes: Open, removed, or pulled-out positions are treated as on; closed, attached, or inserted positions are treated as off. The two paired upper cabinets were split into individual movable leaves as required, although some leaf-specific transition ordering is only weakly resolved by the 8-frame sampling.
scene_description: A user moves through a modern kitchen and sequentially opens and closes appliance doors, cabinet leaves, cooker lids, and an air-fryer basket.
